provenance.dataset: loan_type=2 (FHA); action_taken in {1,2,3} = decisioned; reverse mortgages excluded
provenance.integrity_note: v0: integrity via sha256 + public git history; cryptographic signatures planned

attribution.required_text: Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record; historical aggregate only.

claim.subject: Daphne-Fairhope-Foley, AL metro (MSA 19300)
claim.definition: max minus min observed FHA denial rate among listed lenders with >=100 decisioned applications in this metro
claim.note: Derived statistic; does not appear in raw HMDA. Observed rates are unadjusted for applicant mix.

does_not_establish: expected outcome for any individual applicant
interpretation_boundary.caveat: Historical observations about institutions. Not ratings, not recommendations, not predictions about any individual application. Rates reflect applicant composition as well as lender practice.

related_research.variance_decomposition: 38% of explained variation in FHA denial outcomes attaches to lender identity (national, mix-adjusted).

reproduce.how_to_reproduce: Run this against the raw public CFPB HMDA 2025 file. It should return the same lender rates, and the gap is the highest minus the lowest.
reproduce.sql:
SELECT lei, COUNT(*) AS decisioned,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS denial_rate_pct
FROM lar
WHERE loan_type=2 AND action_taken IN (1,2,3) AND derived_msa_md='19300'
GROUP BY lei HAVING COUNT(*)>=100
ORDER BY denial_rate_pct;
reproduce.common_mistake: Dropping the 100-application floor. Small lenders produce extreme rates on a handful of files and widen the gap artificially. Also exclude reverse mortgages (HECM) — leaving them in changes national and metro figures alike.
reproduce.if_you_get_a_different_number: Tell us: ziyetis@gmail.com. A figure we cannot reproduce goes in the public corrections log at https://financeratecalc.com/corrections.html, dated, with credit to whoever found it.
